This horror is scripted. Your goosebumps are not.
A child abuse call isn't the best way to end a shift but for officers Cane and Adel, it's not just their shift that's about to end.

Director's Statement:
Body Worn Video was an opportunity to get nasty. I've generally worked in more playful horror territory in the past, but when Richard at Orillo brought this idea to me, I couldn't resist.
